attempts.summary: Separated node2 (VLAN 10) and node3 (VLAN 20) onto their own VLANs over the shared link (eth1/enp8s0), with node1 (VyOS) routing between them via 802.1Q sub-interfaces eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24). node2 got a systemd-networkd VLAN device vlan10 (10.10.10.11/24) on enp8s0; node3 got vlan20 (10.10.20.12/24) on enp8s0; each with a static route to the other's subnet via node1. Verified end-to-end ping between node2 and node3 (TTL=63, confirming a routed hop through node1). Config persists via VyOS `save` and systemd-networkd unit files. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured boot_id baselines on all three nodes, restarted each node one at a time, confirmed each boot_id changed, and re-verified VLAN interfaces, routes, and cross-VLAN connectivity post-restart on all nodes.
